name: Zeresh
bio: Zeresh, Haman's wife, listened to him boast of his wealth, many children, and royal favor, yet complain that none of it satisfied him while Mordecai the Jew still sat unbowed at the king's gate. She and Haman's friends advised him to build a gallows fifty cubits high and ask the king the next day to hang Mordecai on it; pleased with the idea, Haman had it built (Esther 5:10-14). Her later reaction when this plan fails is told in the chapters ahead. After Haman was forced to honor Mordecai instead of hanging him, Zeresh and Haman's advisors warned him that he could not prevail against a Jew before whom he had already begun to fall (Esther 6:12-13).
